description: Tahap 5 (T5.1–T5.5) — Quality and correctness pass: edge case tests, rounding/boundary tests, access audit (all endpoints must require login and be grup_id-scoped), UX polish (touch sizes, contrast, loading/empty/error states, 360px audit), and DB performance indexes. No new features — only correctness, coverage, and polish on what FEAT-001 through FEAT-005 built.
steps: 1. Write edge case Vitest tests in `src/features/billing/calculator.test.ts` additions: (a) two concurrent lapangan (two sesi in same pertemuan, different lapangan numbers), (b) penanggung bola pays all ball cost while others pay 0 for ball, (c) bebas_biaya player who pays voluntarily (all goes to kelebihan), (d) kelebihan bayar recorded correctly, (e) new tamu/guest player scenario, (f) Buka Kembali reversal leaves saldo unchanged. Run `pnpm vitest run` — all pass. (T5.1)

2. Write rounding and boundary Vitest tests in `src/lib/money.test.ts` additions and new `src/features/billing/calculator-boundary.test.ts`: (a) non-round harga_bola (e.g. 4750), (b) 2-player session with 1 ball, (c) session with 3+ balls, (d) 5–6 session players with fractional split. Run `pnpm vitest run` — all pass. (T5.2)

3. Audit all API routes under `src/app/api/v1/` — verify every route calls `get-grup-context.ts` and scopes queries with grup_id. Add missing auth guards where found. Write a checklist comment at the top of each route file confirming auth+scoping. (T5.3)

4. UX polish pass across all UI pages: (a) verify all buttons/inputs have min-height 44px (h-11 Tailwind), (b) add loading skeleton components using `src/components/ui/Skeleton.tsx` (create if not exists) to all list pages, (c) add EmptyState component `src/components/ui/EmptyState.tsx` to all list pages when data is empty, (d) add ErrorState component `src/components/ui/ErrorState.tsx` for API errors, (e) add confirmation dialogs (using BottomSheet) for all destructive actions (delete, deactivate, Buka Kembali, buka kunci), (f) test all pages at 360px viewport — zero horizontal scroll. (T5.4)

5. Add DB indexes in `src/db/schema/`: for each table add compound indexes on (grup_id, tanggal) for date-filtered tables, (grup_id, pemain_id) for pemain lookups, (pertemuan_id) for sesi/peserta lookups. Use Drizzle's `index()` helper. Run `pnpm db:generate` to create index migration. (T5.5)
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm vitest run` passes ALL tests including new edge case and boundary tests
Every API route under src/app/api/v1/ uses get-grup-context.ts (no unguarded route)
Every list page has loading skeleton, empty state, and error state
All interactive elements have min 44px touch target size
No horizontal scroll at 360px on any page
`pnpm build` completes with zero errors after this FEAT
